subject: Greenleaf renewal & onboarding — procurement milestone checklist
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@greenleafhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Cc: Leah Kim <lkim@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & onboarding - Greenleaf (term change + capacity uplift)

Hi Laura,

Hope you had a great week. We're kicking off the renewal for our Redwood contract (current term ends 12/31/2027) and need to complete vendor re-onboarding for procurement before legal can sign the amended term. Key asks from Procurement:

- SOC2 summary and attestation evidence (we only need the summary & link to full report)
- Updated SOW or amendment that reflects +30% capacity uplift and a one-year term change to start 1/1/2028
- Instructions for your procurement portal (billing entity, invoice cadence, required PO fields)
- Onboarding agent authorization form filled (Greenleaf requires a named point of contact)

Can you send a short mutual action plan (dates/owners) so our procurement team can schedule the PO creation? Target: PO issued by Oct 8 to align with internal budget windows.

Thanks — we want to avoid delays, so a checklist would be ideal.

Sanjay Rao
Director, Procurement
Greenleaf Health

--
Attachment: none yet; procurement asked for Redwood artifacts
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & onboarding - Greenleaf (term change + capacity uplift)

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear list. I've put together a short procurement milestone checklist below; attaching the SOC2 summary and the onboarding authorization template.

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) Today (Oct 1) — Redwood sends SOC2 summary, onboarding agent authorization, and draft SOW amendment (we'll send SOW in a follow-up from Karthik). Owner: Laura Bennett
2) Oct 2 — Karthik provides updated pricing and SOW amendment reflecting the +30% capacity uplift and term swap. Owner: Karthik Iyer
3) Oct 3 — Legal review & DocuSign routing for the amendment and any IP/attestation addendum. Owner: Marissa Cole (legal)
4) Oct 4–7 — Greenleaf procurement completes portal intake and submits PO for approval. Owner: Greenleaf procurement
5) Oct 8 — Target PO issuance; Redwood to confirm onboarding slot in the week of Oct 10.

Procurement portal fields (what we advise Greenleaf to enter):
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.ai
- Invoice cadence: Net 30 (unless otherwise agreed)
- PO reference: GLF-2027-07-RI

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Onboarding_Agent_Authorization.docx

If those dates work, we'll prepare the SOW amendment and a short acceptance checklist for your portal. Also: please confirm the legal contact who will sign the DocuSign envelope (Leah?) so Marissa can route it correctly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf; Onboarding_Agent_Authorization.docx
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & onboarding - Greenleaf (term change + capacity uplift)

Hi all,

Attached is SOW-Amendment-v2.pdf which updates the commitment from 100k inference units/month to 130k inference units/month (30% uplift) and shifts to a 12-month term starting 2028-01-01. Pricing delta: +$18,750/mo over current committed rate, pro-rated for Jan 2028.

Quick notes for PO:
- Line item 1: Redwood Inference — Renewal addendum (SKU: RI-RENEW-2028) — Qty 12 months — Unit price per month shown on SOW
- Line item 2: Onboarding services (one-time) — $2,500 (if you want an accelerated onboarding window in Oct)

If Greenleaf wants to keep invoice cadence monthly instead of Net 30 aggregated, we can accept monthly invoices but we'd prefer one PO referencing the deal id.

Marissa — please include the IP addendum we discussed if Greenleaf requests it; I left placeholders in the SOW for signatures.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Account Strategy — Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & onboarding - Greenleaf (term change + capacity uplift)

Hi Sanjay / team — looping in on legal & attestation. A couple of items we've prepared to speed procurement:

- IP Addendum & Data Processing Addendum are pre-approved and available via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tx/abcd1234-sign
- Onboarding_Agent_Authorization.docx contains the named contact field required by most hospital procurement teams. Please complete and return.
- I've attached a short attestation template that confirms SOC2 controls relevant to data segmentation and retention; sign-off there will clear the compliance gate for most procurement workflows.

If Greenleaf needs a redline, confirm which clauses you need changed and we'll prioritize a response within 24 hours. We can also route a short SOC2 technical Q&A to your security team if they'd prefer a call.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — quick update from Procurement: we completed the portal intake this morning and raised a PO (PO #43821) referencing GLF-2027-07-RI. Our finance team will route the PO for approval tomorrow; expecting issuance by EOD Oct 8 per our internal schedule.

Attached is a PO stub (PO_43821_stub.pdf) with the line items pulled from the SOW amendment. Leah will be the signer for DocuSign (Leah Kim, lkim@greenleafhealth.com) — Marissa, please route the IP/Data addendum there.

Greenleaf next steps for Redwood: once PO is issued, confirm the onboarding time slot (we'd prefer week of Oct 10). Also send invoice instructions and a final PDF of the SOW with signature placeholders populated.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this checklist is working well.

Sanjay Rao
Director, Procurement
Greenleaf Health
